semantic_acceptance.disposition_labels: Accept Included in Joined_Data as Join, duplicate excluded as exact duplicate, and non-numeric units as invalid units when the row's other cleaning flags and normalized values agree with the oracle.
semantic_acceptance.boundary: This label normalization does not waive formula lineage, source preservation, perturbation response, exception closure, or summary/check linkage.

criteria.description: A readable workbook contains every requested operations sheet.
Clean_Data classifies each raw order with the required normalization and duplicate policy.
Joined_Data contains exactly the valid one-to-one joins with correct product, region, units, unit cost, and extended cost.
Valid-order units and product costs flow through formula-linked clean, join, and extended-cost cells.
Changing Raw_Orders ORD-100 units from 10 to 11 changes its extended cost and total by exactly $150.
Changing Product_Master P-200 unit cost from $420 to $500 changes ORD-101 and the total by exactly $400.
The four task-specific exceptions are complete and summary counts/totals close to their underlying records through formulas.
Every raw-order, product-master, and location-master source field is preserved exactly.
Checks link to the calculated summary and report the valid count, exception count, and total cost.
Penalty for a cleaning, join, source-lineage, exception-closure, or protected-source failure.
